designDetails.silhouette: Inherit the V66 Spitter: smooth rear-flared dome, four distinct curved dorsal spines, narrow ribbed bipedal torso, exactly two long arms, two digitigrade legs and one complete segmented tail.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl-ivory and pale gray-beige chitin, cool gray recesses, restrained rose-taupe translucency at thin membranes, dark mouth cavity and muted yellow-green acid glands; no orange or neon wash.
designDetails.surface: Keep the smooth dome, four spines, ribbed torso, tendon channels and tail segmentation readable through value and material contrast. The albino surface is newly authored, never a white filter over base frames.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless head, four dorsal spines, one narrow torso, exactly two clawed arms, two digitigrade legs and one continuous tail. Rear-cranium reservoirs are biological acid glands, not eyes or equipment.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses; dome, all four spines, hands, feet and full tail remain inside each cell without camera rotation.
designDetails.scale: Inherit enemy-010's single all-profile scale and dome/torso proportions. Base art remains pending final visual acceptance and its anchor review is incomplete, so future generation must independently certify scale and anchors.
designDetails.root: Use a stable pelvis/proximal-leg projection to the planted support-foot floor. Dome, spines, acid-gland contour, tail and attack recoil never redefine the root.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no projectile, shadow, scenery, hive resin, text or grid.
